title: Arthur Cayley: Collected Mathematical Papers, Source-Checked Modern LaTeX Slice Readers
description:
Dedicated Arthur Cayley author record for source-checked modern LaTeX slice readers, repaired diagrams, TeX sources, and continuation manifests. The current reader surface includes a complete source-checked Volume I reader and volume-level slice readers for most collected-papers volumes. This 2026-06-03 refresh promotes the scan-backed native TikZ reconstruction of the Volume XIII square diagrams for Paper 966, updates the adjacent table row, and rebuilds the Volume XIII reader. It preserves the earlier scan-backed repairs for the Volume IV hexahedron net in Paper 259, the Volume X theta-characteristic geometric symbols in Paper 701, the Volume X p. 347 annexed diagram for the 179 irreducible syzygies in Paper 693, and the Volume V p. 463 secondary-caustic plot in Paper 359. The source/manifest supplement now also includes the Cayley progress and cost inventory, which separates represented TeX coverage from source-checked faithful transcription. The remaining Volume XIII Table of Conjugates is still tracked as open work because the rotated printed table needs cell-by-cell audit.

Status at a glance. [########--] public reader coverage: thousands of rendered pages across current volume readers, including rebuilt 421-page Volume II and 488-page Volume XIII readers; [#######---] scan-faithful cleanup: many diagrams, determinant arrays, and known malformed areas repaired, with remaining open work concentrated in dense tables, plates, or table-layout pages tracked in the manifest and residual-marker scan; [#########-] provenance: source TeX chunks, repair packets, audit notes, and GitHub mirror preserved, while large raw provenance remains on the main preservation record.
notes: Dedicated Cayley author DOI. This patch updates selected reader PDFs plus the source/manifest supplement; large raw provenance remains on the main preservation record.
